name: Leryn
summary: Leryn is finished entirely in vintage brass, giving the piece a rich, continuous glow with a sculptural, metallic depth. The unified finish creates a bold, modern silhouette with a refined, elevated character. All painted in vintage brass 48×44.5×64.2
